notes.title: Patch 0.5.2
notes.content:
[h2]The Big Book of Monsters: First Update Now Live![/h2]

[b]Greetings, adventurers!  [/b]
We’re thrilled to announce the first update to *The Big Book of Monsters*. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’ve been working hard to bring some exciting new features and improvements to the game. Here’s what’s new:

---

[b]Bug Fixes and Buff Balancing[/b]
No adventure is without its quirks, and we’ve squashed some pesky bugs related to buffs. These fixes ensure your buffs are working exactly as intended, making your battles smoother and more rewarding.  

---
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313513/24bda171c16c7920a9ed6a0a5a6e4f0774ca5db4.png[/img]

[b]New Backgrounds for Each Adventure[/b]
Immerse yourself in your quests like never before with unique backgrounds tailored to each adventure! From eerie forests to spooky dungeons, each journey now feels more alive and visually distinct. 

---
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313513/788c41c6b25ef00efa1928557a248b2ba84c0f0d.png[/img]

[b]Monsters Galore[/b]
We’ve expanded the roster of creatures you’ll encounter in Adventures 1-3. These new additions bring fresh challenges to overcome and exciting rewards to earn. Keep your weapons ready and your wits sharp — you never know what lurks ahead!

---
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313513/d8578d8688b512a619370276c67c0d4e0d9b1660.png[/img]
[b]Alchemy Overhaul[/b]
Alchemy has been revamped to give you more insight into your brewing process.  
- **Supply Tracker:** View exactly what ingredients you have on hand and what you still need.  
- **User-Friendly Interface:** Crafting potions has never been easier, with a clearer and more intuitive alchemy menu.  

Get ready to brew your way to victory with confidence and precision.

---

[b]Discord Button on the Sidebar[/b]
We’re building a community of monster slayers!  
A new Discord button on the main sidebar connects you directly to our official server. Join fellow players to share tips, showcase your achievements, or just hang out. Let’s make the *Big Book of Monsters* community as lively as the game itself!

---

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
This update is just the beginning. We're hard at work planning more adventures, challenges, and surprises for you. Your continued support and feedback will guide us as we shape the future of *The Big Book of Monsters*. 

---

[b]Ready to Dive In?[/b]
Update your game today and experience these changes for yourself! As always, we’re eager to hear your thoughts, so drop by the Discord or leave a review. 

Thank you for being part of our journey. Happy adventuring!  
— The *Big Book of Monsters* Team

notes.title: Launch Day Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Launch Day for The Big Book of Monsters![/h1]

[i]TL;DR: The game is live! Join the conversation, share your feedback, and stay updated on future content by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/zjD6QtcPsM]Discord community[/url]. Let’s build this adventure together![/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313513/837e332709c264a5f5c5c60b072a573419352100.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313513/0675da09a7c33c829a7a420dfd1d5d7b4310b9d4.png[/img][/url]

Today’s the day! After months of hard work, countless playtests, and your incredible feedback during development, The Big Book of Monsters is officially live on Steam! This game has been a passion project, blending my love for world-building, adventure, and monster design into an experience I hope you’ll find as exciting to play as I did to create.

But launch day is just the beginning. Let’s talk about what’s next.

[h2]The Road Ahead[/h2]
I believe a good game grows with its community, and I already have a roadmap packed with updates to enhance your adventures. Here's a sneak peek at what you can expect in the coming weeks and months.

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
First up, I’ll be focusing on polishing the Alchemy system. A few changes are in the works to make potion brewing more intuitive and rewarding:

[list]
[*] Quantity Display: You’ll soon be able to see exactly how many of each potion you have in your inventory at a glance.
[*] Brew-Ready Indicators: A visual signifier will let you know if you have the ingredients needed to craft a potion. No more guessing—if you can brew it, you’ll know!
[*] These updates will streamline the brewing process and make crafting a more strategic part of your monster-hunting journey.
[/list]

[h2]More Monsters, More Adventures[/h2]
Every adventure needs more challenges, and I’m excited to expand the world of The Big Book of Monsters with:

[list]
[*] New Monsters: I’m adding a slew of creatures to test your strategies and keep combat fresh.
[*] Dynamic Environments: Each adventure will soon feature unique backdrops, bringing the world to life in new and vibrant ways.
[*] New Adventures: Two additional adventures are planned to help balance the difficulty curve and offer fresh opportunities for exploration.
[/list]

[h2]A Big New Feature: Blacksmithing and Equipment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313513/e047a0619b803b29fe31f3b7a8440fdd2802a41f.png[/img]
This is the update I’m most excited to share with you! Coming soon is a whole new system that will deepen your gameplay experience:


[list]
[*] Blacksmithing: Collect crafting drops from your adventures and bring them to the blacksmith to forge powerful equipment.
[*] Gear and Upgrades: Equip your hero with weapons and armor to boost their stats and customize your playstyle.
[*] Smoothing the Difficulty Curve: This feature will give you more control over your power level, making the toughest challenges more manageable while rewarding your effort.
[*] Blacksmithing will transform how you approach your journey, giving you even more ways to strategize and take down the toughest monsters.
[/list]

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
Whether you’ve been following the game’s development from the beginning or you’re just diving in now, I want to say a huge thank you for your support. Games like this wouldn’t be possible without a passionate community, and I’m so excited to grow this world with you.

So gear up, gather your potions, and dive into The Big Book of Monsters! And don’t forget to share your feedback—I’m always listening and can’t wait to hear your thoughts on where we should take this adventure next.

Happy monster hunting!

— Sam Cherry (Lead Developer)
